svg.text: “SWITCH TO TRANSPARENCY” – the message Earshot sends when you tap Ambient
01 = “current mode” (02 would be the hold-cycle mask) · 01 = fixed · 02 = transparency
modes: 01 off · 02 transparency · ANC strengths 04 mild · 10 moderate · 08 deep · 20 adaptive
THE COMMAND TABLE (a reply sets bit 15: 0x0106 → 0x8106)
No checksum: RFCOMM already guarantees the bytes arrive intact. seq just counts up; replies echo it.
Black: read · blue: write · red: the buds speak first. Codes match Gadgetbridge and were verified on the Buds Air 7.
